title: Jazzy Snappy Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A buttery and snappy Tunisian dish featuring tamarind pulp and bonito shave, perfect for a hangover cure, this keto friendly recipe is a must try.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of butter in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute, until the spices are fragrant.
Add the tamarind pulp and bonito flakes, and stir to combine.
Add 1 cup of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter, until melted and combined.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
